methods.label: Clear the denominators
methods.explanation: Multiply both sides by 6: \(3(x+1)-2(2x-1)\geq6\), or \(-x+5\geq6\), giving \(-x\geq1\). Dividing both sides by -1 reverses the inequality sign, giving \(x\leq-1\).
methods.levelReason: The denominators are nonzero constants. Clearing them, expanding, and reversing the inequality after negative division use Grade 7 procedures.
